gemini.prompt_template:
Today is {today}. I already have these celebrity news stories from RSS feeds: {covered_summary}

Search for celebrity and entertainment news from today that is NOT already covered above.
Focus on these topics that RSS feeds tend to miss:
- reality_tv: Real Housewives, Bravo shows, Bachelor/Bachelorette drama, Love Island
- music_film: new album/song releases, movie news, award shows, box office

DO NOT include URLs. Return JSON with 2 keys, each 3 story objects (title, summary 2 sentences, source, date):
{"reality_tv":[],"music_film":[]}
Return ONLY valid JSON. No Meghan Markle.
